volunteerWork.taskIntro: Create and publish work for approved volunteers. Assign people and follow the work through to completion.
volunteerWork.mineIntro: See your assignments, update their progress and log completed service.
volunteerWork.hoursIntro: Log service only for a task you have been assigned. Only approved hours count towards recognition.
volunteerWork.certificateIntro: Request a numbered certificate for your approved service. Each certificate records the total at issue; older certificates remain valid as your total grows.
volunteerWork.approvedTotal: Approved service: {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
volunteerWork.title: Task title (required)
volunteerWork.noPrivate: Use only task instructions. Do not include personal or safeguarding information.
volunteerWork.error: Could not save. Check the current state and the details supplied.
volunteerWork.not_volunteer: The selected person is not an approved volunteer.
volunteerWork.task_not_accepting_hours: This task is not accepting hours.
volunteerWork.worked_on_in_future: Work date cannot be in the future.
volunteerWork.before_assignment: Work date cannot be before your assignment.
volunteerWork.after_unassignment: Work date cannot be after your assignment ended.
volunteerWork.day_limit_exceeded: Total non-rejected service for one day cannot exceed 24 hours.
volunteerWork.nothing_to_certify: You need approved hours before requesting a certificate.
volunteerWork.certificate_revoked: The service certificate for this total was revoked. Contact the community team to discuss it.
volunteerWork.forbidden: You do not have access to this volunteer work.
